entry.title: Junologue Chorus 0.1.2
entry.summary: Juno-60 chorus emulation: the two BBD modes with mix and brightness. Port of the Schwung module **Junologue Chorus** by charlesvestal to the MPC/Force plugin host, compiled unchanged from `charlesvestal/schwung-junologue-chorus` at `0b1ecd9d09da` (`MIT`), linked with the mpc-vst-plugins VST2 wrapper and this repository's Schwung adapter `adapters/schwungfx/`. Gen1 build: armv7, glibc ≤ 2.29. ## Sources - module: https://github.com/charlesvestal/schwung-junologue-chorus/tree/0b1ecd9d09daad91b5726
